competitor_takeaways: The local_pack is contested by three genuinely local operators (Jim's Cleaning Mentone, PG Cleaning Group, Euro Clean — all 5★, all with a Mentone-area phone number or address) rather than national aggregators, meaning local-pack presence and a local phone number carry real weight for this exact query
